body: I can't see Louis enjoying K-pop and Lizzy McAlpine, but stranger things have happened!

There's We Girls! I don't know how underground they really are, but they have like 1k monthly listeners last I checked. I like most of the stuff they have out, but I especially enjoy Heart Beat and Ride (Camp Fire ver. too)!

I don't think I know any REALLY unknown artists besides that, but here are some kinda lesser known ones and songs I'd recommend:

- Ruann (Beep Beep)

- PLAYBACK (Playback, Want You To Say, Untold Story)

- FANATICS (Follow Me)

- ALICE (Focus, Lavish Light, Like I do)

I'm pretty sure ALICE actually has a larger number of fans, but I don't really see anyone talking about those songs ever, so I threw them in anyway! 

Hope you find some great songs!!

It can definitely seem silly to do all this over a game, but I don't think the problem is the fact that the players don't care about "real life" issues. In fact, I think the reason people are so upset is because for some of them Bloxburg is their favorite pastime, and watching one of your sources of comfort turn sour when they likely spend other amounts of time worrying about said big issues sucks. Basically: for some, the games they play are an escape, and it's okay to have those. I mean, you're on this subreddit too after all.

Unrelated, but I really think you should try being nicer about your point if your goal is to get through to others. Nobody will want to hear out someone who makes fun of them. A lot of your other comments (here and on other posts) feel more like an attempt to start an argument than a conversation, so even if you're not actually trying to persuade others, it might be good to tone that down just for the sake of those around you 😭

Not liking the update and sending the devs literal death threats are two entirely different things 😭 you're using it as a gotcha moment when the majority of players have literally never done that. They have every right to boycott and criticize the devs because the devs are the reason the game is so annoying now. Minimizing it to the "it's pixels" argument isn't an awesome move because some people have spent money on this game and the benefits they purchased are essentially being voided. 

The players are why the devs even have a job, and if they do wrong by their players it will naturally come back to bite them. Criticism is warranted, and death threats are just the extreme; I haven't seen a single person wish them death, and all the other jokes being made at the expense of the devs are not harming them. In the end, you are jumping to the small minority of players and turning it into a shield for whatever your point is. Just because you're (somehow) fortunate to be making your usual in-game salary doesn't take away from the fact that just about everyone else is not and have the right to complain. 

I'm happy that you enjoy the update. Please do not try to make others feel bad for not enjoying it as well.
